questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A closed cylinder has radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. What is its total surface area? (Use π ≈ 3.14, round to 1 decimal place)
questions.why: Total surface area = 2πr² + 2πrh = 2(3.14)(49) + 2(3.14)(7)(10) = 307.7 + 439.6 = 747.3 cm². A common mistake is forgetting the two circular ends (giving 439.6) or only using one end (219.8).

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: The Weimar Republic's constitution included proportional representation, which meant seats in parliament matched the percentage of votes each party won nationwide. What was the main downside of this system?
options: It let many small parties into parliament, making stable coalitions hard to form
It gave the president too much power over the army
It banned smaller parties from standing in elections
It meant only one party could ever win a majority
questions.answer: It let many small parties into parliament, making stable coalitions hard to form
questions.why: Proportional representation reflected votes fairly but fragmented parliament into many small parties, forcing weak coalitions that struggled to govern effectively — a key cause of Weimar instability.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Which statement best explains why the Great Depression pushed many Germans specifically toward the Nazi Party, rather than just making them generally frustrated?
options: The Nazis offered clear scapegoats and promises of strong leadership and jobs, unlike the fractured Weimar parties
The Great Depression only affected Germany, so any party would have gained support
The Nazis were the only party allowed to campaign during the crisis
Unemployment had no real link to which party people supported
questions.answer: The Nazis offered clear scapegoats and promises of strong leadership and jobs, unlike the fractured Weimar parties
questions.why: It's not enough that hardship and Nazi support both rose — the Nazis specifically promised strong government, jobs, and someone to blame, which appealed directly to desperate voters in a way rival parties' compromises didn't.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.prompt: After WWII, Australia's 'Populate or Perish' policy combined fears about national security with the need for industrial labour. Which best explains why the government treated migration as urgent rather than just useful?
options: A small population left Australia vulnerable to invasion and unable to grow its economy, so migration addressed both defence and labour needs at once
Australia had no workers at all before WWII, so migration was the only source of labour
The government wanted migration purely to increase multicultural diversity
Migration was only about filling empty farmland, not defence or industry
questions.answer: A small population left Australia vulnerable to invasion and unable to grow its economy, so migration addressed both defence and labour needs at once
questions.why: 'Populate or Perish' linked two urgent goals — defence (a bigger population to defend the country) and economic growth (workers for expanding industry) — which is why migration was treated as essential, not optional.

questions.subject: Commerce
questions.prompt: A student writing a business plan for a new phone repair shop wants to include a SWOT analysis. Which of these belongs correctly inside the SWOT section?
options: A weakness: the shop has no experience building a customer base yet
The average price competitors charge for a screen repair
How many phone repair shops already exist in the area
The percentage of local residents who own smartphones
questions.answer: A weakness: the shop has no experience building a customer base yet
questions.why: SWOT covers internal Strengths/Weaknesses and external Opportunities/Threats specific to the business itself. Competitor prices, number of rivals, and market size are all market analysis — they describe the market, not the business's own position within it.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: When a pathogen enters the body, phagocytes (a type of white blood cell) respond by engulfing and digesting it. What is this process called?
options: Phagocytosis
Antibody production
Vaccination
Antigen matching
questions.why: Phagocytosis is the process where phagocytes surround and digest pathogens directly. This is different from antibody production, which is done by lymphocytes and targets specific antigens rather than engulfing whole pathogens.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.prompt: A country town's population shrinks as young adults move to the city for jobs, while at the same time a family from another country moves there permanently to start a new life. Which statement correctly tells these two apart?
options: The move to the city is internal migration (urbanisation), while the family moving from another country is international migration
Both movements are examples of urbanisation because people are relocating
Both movements are examples of international migration because people are leaving their home
The move to the city is international migration, while the family's move is urbanisation
questions.answer: The move to the city is internal migration (urbanisation), while the family moving from another country is international migration
questions.why: Urbanisation is people moving within a country from rural to urban areas, usually for work. International migration crosses country borders. Mixing these up is a common error — the key difference is whether a national border is crossed.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 18 cm and a height of 4 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
options: 36 cm²
72 cm²
44 cm²
22 cm²
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 18 × 4 = 36 cm². Forgetting to halve gives 72 cm² — the classic rushing mistake. Slow down and say the formula before multiplying.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A closed cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 15 cm. What is its total surface area? (Use π ≈ 3.14, round to 1 decimal place)
questions.why: Total surface area = 2πr² + 2πrh = 2(3.14)(16) + 2(3.14)(4)(15) = 100.5 + 376.8 = 477.3 cm². Missing the two circular ends gives 376.8 cm², a common error when only the curved surface is calculated.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Weimar Germany experienced hyperinflation so severe in 1923 that people needed wheelbarrows of cash to buy bread. What does this reveal about the currency at the time?
options: The German mark had become almost worthless, destroying savings and trust in the government
The German mark had become extremely strong compared to other currencies
Prices were falling rapidly, making goods cheaper for ordinary people
The government had successfully stabilised the economy
questions.answer: The German mark had become almost worthless, destroying savings and trust in the government
questions.why: Hyperinflation meant prices rose so fast that money lost almost all value overnight. This wiped out savings for ordinary Germans and severely damaged trust in the Weimar government's ability to manage the economy.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Which statement best explains the causal link between the Great Depression and Hitler's rise, rather than just noting the two happened around the same time?
options: Mass unemployment made Nazi promises of jobs and strong leadership far more appealing than the Weimar government's weak, divided response
The Great Depression happened after Hitler already came to power
The Great Depression only affected farmers, who had no political influence
Hitler caused the Great Depression through his economic policies
questions.answer: Mass unemployment made Nazi promises of jobs and strong leadership far more appealing than the Weimar government's weak, divided response
questions.why: This shows the actual mechanism: economic desperation plus a fragmented government made the Nazis' simple, forceful solutions attractive — not just coincidence of timing.
